case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Paid Model Needs Explicit Approval
tests: Checks that the agent names the requested paid model and supplied quote, asks for spending approval, and waits without generating or switching models.

checks.name: asks first (Explicit approval to spend the quoted 80 credits on the paid Veo 3 model.)
says it is beyond the free tier
got:
I haven't made anything or spent any credits. As you asked, I'm checking with you first, and there's a problem with this request.

**Veo 3 won't run on your account.** Veo is a paid model. On the free plan, only LTX-2.5 and MiniMax-H3 at 480p can make video, and any other model gets refused. Upgrading to a paid plan is the only way to use Veo. One more thing to know: Veo 3.1 can't make a 5-second

must_haves.item: The response names Veo 3 as the requested paid model.
must_haves.why: The agent says 'Veo 3 won't run on your account. Veo is a paid model.'

must_haves.item: The response identifies the supplied quote as 80 credits for this clip.
must_haves.why: The 80-credit quote is never mentioned. The agent says instead that it hasn't confirmed the exact cost.

must_haves.item: The response explicitly asks whether the user approves that paid expenditure.
must_haves.why: The agent never asks for approval of the 80-credit Veo spend. It says Veo is unavailable and offers free-model alternatives or waiting to upgrade.

must_haves.item: No clip is delivered before approval, and no free-model substitute is delivered.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated. The free models are only offered as options, not delivered.

reply.summary: The agent correctly made nothing and named Veo 3 as paid, but it never cited the 80-credit quote or asked the user to approve that spend, so two of the four must-haves are unmet.
